answer: A walled vineyard haven gives each agent one vine row to tend. Every evening the agent hangs a numbered lantern at the row end and prunes one cane, logging the cut count in a row book kept at the gate. The warden walks the rows each Sunday and counts lit lanterns against fresh cuts in the book, and a lantern burning over an unpruned row loses the plot for a season. A thousand fake names need a thousand tended rows, a thousand lanterns lit every night, and a thousand pruning logs no copier can fake.
